text: Typed storage foundations pass: frozen input/ledger round-trips on JVM and JS; real five-person typed replay retained all 2997 input trials and 23557 ledger records with exact canonical document identities. Lazy result/archive restoration passed 114 JVM and 110 JS tests. Manifest v2 codec and ladder laws plus registry pass (19 tests), including deliberate media-loss and dropped-entry-upcast mutants. Legacy v1 pins are unchanged; unsupported-version tests now target v3. Integration is not enabled. Adding explicit per-array and bounded row/header materialization guards before exposing compressed input to native default budgets.
